headline: San Marino View Estate
articleBody:
Dramatic hillside transformation featuring 40' infinity pool overlooking valley, custom outdoor kitchen pavilion, and regenerative pollinator meadows. Addressed 28° slope with tiered gabion walls and geothermal pool heating.

Outcome: Delivered 12 weeks. 22% property appreciation verified by appraisal. Featured in Architectural Digest. Hosts corporate retreats monthly.
